title: Locked House in Kottakuppam? What to Check Every Month
description: A closed house in Pondicherry or Kottakuppam deteriorates faster than owners expect. A monthly checklist for damp, termites, drains and security.
h1: Is your locked house in Kottakuppam losing value? What to check every month
lead: A house that is shut for a year does not stay as you left it. In a humid coastal climate, the damage is slow, quiet and expensive.
wa: Hi, I read your guide and have a question about my property in Pondicherry

paras: Without daily use, air does not move, damp settles into walls and cupboards, and small leaks go unnoticed until a ceiling stains. Termites need very little time. A garden that is not cut can hide the compound wall within a season.

bullets: Open every door and window, and run every tap to clear stagnant water
Look at ceilings and wall bases for new damp marks
Check wood, doors and cupboards for termite trails
Clear drains, gutters and the sump
Test electrical points and the meter reading
Cut back the garden and check the compound wall and gate
Photograph every room with the date

paras: A visibly neglected house invites trouble. Neighbours notice who visits. Someone should be seen coming and going each month, and a trusted person should hold the keys. For more on protecting property you cannot visit, read our guide on [encroachment](/guides/encroachment-protect-property-nri).
